recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless the work group later reopens Extension.url versioning or canonical datatype behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-28143 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking to change the extensibility Extension.url note from saying the URL SHALL be the canonical URL of a StructureDefinition to saying it SHALL be a reference to that canonical URL, clarifying that Extension.url is not the canonical datatype.
initial_application: Git commit 34f08837d9a4e13f9b9101a7280c205102450804 explicitly applied FHIR-28143 by changing source/extensibility.html to the requested reference-to-canonical wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps the extension page to source/extensibility.html. The linked Zulip thread confirms Extension.url is typed uri and intentionally cannot include a canonical |version suffix. FHIR-8966 is historical background for the earlier StructureDefinition/canonical-URL phrasing, and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-28143 reference or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/extensibility.html:67 already says Extension.url SHALL be a reference to the canonical URL of the StructureDefinition defining the extension, and an exact source search found no remaining old requirement wording.
